10k.note: 10-K parsed; describes two infrared-spectroscopy decision-support devices (PressureSafe, DiaSafe). Neither is a drug; no P1/P2/P3 drug trials disclosed.

ctgov.note: No P1-P3 drug trials sponsored by IR-Med on ClinicalTrials.gov. PressureSafe observational study at Methodist Healthcare is a non-IDE device usability/clinical study for an FDA Class I listed device.

products.name: PressureSafe
products.indication: Early assessment of pressure injuries (PI), including in dark skin tones
products.regulatory_status: FDA listed (Class I); commercial launch initially planned 2H 2025
products.ongoing_clinical_activity: Observational clinical study at Methodist Healthcare; ~294 scans Phase 1 data showed ~90% sensitivity (non-pivotal device study, not a drug P1/P2/P3 trial)

products.name: DiaSafe
products.modality: Handheld near-infrared spectroscopy decision-support device (PressureSafe platform extension)
products.indication: Early assessment of diabetic foot ulcers (DFU)
products.regulatory_status: In development; planned clinical study in Israel; Israel Innovation Authority grant ~$500k

excluded_preclinical: DiaSafe — DFU device still in development; planned algorithm-training clinical study in Israel.
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: IR-Med is a small medical-device company developing infrared-spectroscopy point-of-care decision-support devices (PressureSafe, DiaSafe). No proprietary P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline; ongoing device studies are observational/usability for an FDA Class I listed device, not pivotal IDE trials.
